purpose: Introduce a commonly used name or category.
keywords: This is what is known as a fermented food.
He is what people call a morning person and goes to bed early.
I do not want to aim only at so-called success.
restrictions: Signals a familiar label, sometimes with distance from that label.
mistake: It does not itself prove the label is accurate.
